Files up to the existing 50 MiB bounded-download limit return bytes with a valid, non-reserved stored media type; invalid or parameterized values and the reserved download-information type fall back to application/octet-stream. Larger Files return application/vnd.tidb-link.file-download+json with a short-lived bearer URL. Only the owner User API Key may obtain a URL; its holder can redeem it without a key. A new authorized read issues a fresh download URL without changing the File or upload expiry.

put.description:
No API Key is required. Send every returned uploadUrl header and exactly Content-Length bytes. The ticket is valid for 60 seconds at admission; the upload intent retains its own expiry. An identical repeated PUT returns the same ready File. Replay the original create request and Idempotency-Key to obtain a fresh URL. Responses, including errors, are non-cacheable and allow any browser origin without credentials.

Authorization: short-lived content-bound upload ticket; no API Key required.

503.description: upload_temporarily_unavailable: ticket key, byte budget, provider or persistence is unavailable; also returned when the 16 per-process upload slots are busy or the independent 120-second request deadline expires. Cancellation prevents new writes but cannot roll back an already-started write. Retry according to error.details.retryAfterSeconds.
